description.fun: Pidove isn't the brightest bird: it's so forgetful that it will wait for a new order from its Trainer even right after being given one. Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity. Flocks gather in city parks and plazas, so be careful scattering food, as several hundred may turn up at once. Its heart-shaped chest is a pun on hato, Japanese for 'pigeon', and 'heart'.
description.guide: Pidove is a Normal- and Flying-type pigeon Pokémon common in city parks and plazas. It is friendly and obedient but forgetful, and sometimes fails to understand complicated commands. It evolves into Tranquill and then Unfezant.
description.tagline: A friendly, forgetful city pigeon with a heart on its chest.

description.fun: Tranquill never gets lost: however far it flies, it always finds its way back to its nest and its Trainer, so delivery workers often choose it as a partner. Many people believe that deep in the forests where Tranquill live lies a peaceful place where there is no war, which may nod to Ihatov, the ideal land of Kenji Miyazawa's stories. It's based on the oriental turtle dove and the homing pigeon.
description.guide: Tranquill is the evolved form of Pidove, a Normal- and Flying-type bird with an excellent memory and sense of direction. It can always return to its Trainer and nest, however far it travels. It evolves into Unfezant.
description.tagline: A homing pigeon that always finds its way back.

description.fun: Unfezant are proud, clever birds that refuse to feel close to anyone but their Trainers. Males and females look very different: males have a pink wattle with long ribbons they swing to threaten foes and fly faster, while females lack it but have more stamina. It's based on a pheasant, perhaps the green pheasant, Japan's national bird, and its Japanese name echoes a pheasant's cry.
description.guide: Unfezant is the final form of Pidove, a Normal- and Flying-type pheasant Pokémon. Males have long head plumage they swing to threaten opponents, while females are stronger fliers. It is proud and bonds only with its Trainer.
description.tagline: A proud pheasant: males have the plumes, females the stamina.
